description: Project hooks. The codex-harness-kit entries call .codex/harness/*.py.

hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py" --snapshot; fi

d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.codex/harness/guard.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/harness/guard.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.codex/harness/guard.py"; fi; echo '{}'

d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.codex/harness/verify.py"; fi; echo '{}'
